name: Maya Johnson
title: Public Health Program Coordinator
bio: Maya is an early-career public health professional interested in community health, health equity, and program development. Her experience includes supporting community-based initiatives, conducting research, and communicating health information to diverse audiences. She is particularly interested in opportunities that use evidence-based strategies to improve access to health resources and strengthen community well-being.

projects.name: Community Health Needs Assessment
projects.description: Analyzed community health information to identify priority needs and opportunities for improving access to local health resources.

name: Daniel Kim
title: Data Analyst
bio: Daniel is an early-career data analyst interested in using data to support organizational decision-making and community impact. His experience includes cleaning datasets, identifying trends, developing reports, and communicating findings to nontechnical audiences. He is interested in opportunities that combine analytical problem-solving with practical business and community applications.
degree: Master of Science in Data Analytics

projects.name: Community Resource Dashboard
projects.description: Developed an interactive dashboard to summarize community resource data and make key trends easier for stakeholders to understand.

name: Sofia Martinez
title: Project Coordinator
bio: Sofia is an early-career project coordinator with experience supporting team operations, organizing project timelines, and communicating across stakeholders. She is interested in roles that combine project management, process improvement, and community-focused work. Her strengths include organization, collaboration, and helping teams move projects from planning through completion.

projects.name: Community Program Coordination Initiative
projects.description: Coordinated project activities, timelines, and stakeholder communication for a community-focused program.

name: Jordan Williams
title: Junior Web Developer
bio: Jordan is an early-career web developer interested in building accessible and user-friendly digital experiences. Jordan has experience creating responsive websites and organizing structured content using foundational web technologies. Professional interests include front-end development, accessibility, and using technology to support organizations and communities.
degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

projects.name: Community Organization Website
projects.description: Developed a responsive informational website that helped a community organization present programs and resources online.

name: Priya Patel
title: Business Analyst
bio: Priya is an early-career business analyst interested in using data, research, and process improvement to support organizational decision-making. Her experience includes analyzing business information, preparing reports, identifying operational opportunities, and communicating findings to stakeholders. She is interested in roles that combine analytics, strategy, and measurable organizational impact.

projects.name: Operational Performance Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed operational data and developed recommendations for improving reporting processes and organizational efficiency.
